title: [2.8.2] AndroidAPS forgets it just bolussed/issues double bolus
body:
AndroidAPS sometimes forgets it just bolussed (SMB) and also sometimes issues a double bolus (SMB) within a minute which might be a connected issue. When re-reading pump history, AndroidAPS doesn't know those bolusses were SMBs but thinks the user entered them on the pump.

I kind of hope this happens due to a corrupted database and uninstalling and re-installing would fix it but to make sure this isn't a serious bug I thought I should report the behaviour here.

It seems to me that quite often something triggers a re-run of the algorithm not just after a new bg value was received while AndroidAPS was already communicating with the pump and AndroidAPS then wants to send a different command to the pump. Maybe something is being screwed in those cases and a bolus occurs that isn't being recorded.

This has now happened about four times that I know of.

Let's give you some screenshots first:
![Screenshot_20211028-190935_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6848629/139663987-c0b7c997-3a8f-4d0d-9daa-b5c3f51c922a.jpg)
![Screenshot_20211028-191047_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6848629/139663990-e619ddc3-b1d0-42de-8cc1-bb518894c46b.png)
![Screenshot_20211028-191108_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6848629/139663993-63f98e30-1485-45a7-9876-db18db909143.jpg)
![Screenshot_20211028-191315_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6848629/139663994-6d59d7cc-d56b-41d5-9e2e-e5939109cacc.jpg)

Here's also a video of the pump history:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6848629/139664309-fa4bf1e4-e8dc-4ad0-a0c2-b088323f3b69.mp4

Here are the logs:
[Log - double bolus.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7452833/Log.-.double.bolus.zip)

System:
AndroidAPS 2.8.2 194549adc
Oneplus 3T Android 11 (LineageOS)
Medtronic 554/523 (happens on both)
RileyLink
Dexcom G6 over xdrip
